note: Two lists, both one-directional. "divergences" records values the runtime stylesheets spend that the design system does not declare. "scrimExemptions" records rules that cover the Grid Plane without being opaque, which Law 7 refuses. Every entry carries the reason it is still here. Neither list may grow to make a run pass: remove an entry when the cause is fixed, and the run fails until you do.
